name: inmation-crash-dump-analyzer
description: Dump analysis for the inmation / OT Data Fabric server. crash-dump-analyzer agent and crash-dump-analysis skill: scripts that summarize Windows crash dumps and Linux core dumps (cdb / gdb, verified symbols, Lua / Web API context, C++ exception decoding), search TFS for existing bugs, and collect code evidence for the root cause. perf-counter-analyzer agent and perf-counter-analysis skill: read the performance counters of objects from a Windows dump, plot them, and find correlations between counters. Works from any workspace; uses the inmation server repository when it is the workspace.
